human_review.description: Pause the workflow so someone can review the details before it continues. Use this when a person should check something important.
human_review.name: human_review

parameters.description: What the reviewer sees while the run is paused: the question to answer or the details to check.
parameters.name: content

returns.description: What the reviewer typed before letting the workflow continue.
examples: Approved. The totals match the purchase order.

description: Pause a workflow for someone to review.
